pre_mortem: It's Monday and both lost because the missing spread was a Baltimore layup the form already hinted at: Henry's 22-carry pace and Jackson's 42.3 rushing yards per game put Tennessee in a hole, Ward's -0.19 EPA versus no-blitz (Baltimore blitzes only 37%) never sustained drives, and Pollard finished under 10 carries and under 48. Bateman's 125 yards on 13 targets was one explosive rather than a 4-target floor, so with the lead Baltimore handed it to Henry and Bateman saw two targets and finished under 27. That counter is real but not stronger than the reads: both lines sit well under the only production sample in the pack, and a blowout is not in the data.
slip_story: One form-only competitive script, not a blowout and not a shootout: Tennessee runs at Baltimore's 4.13 YPC defense (Pollard rush over 48) while Baltimore keeps the receiving roles already present in the Henry-heavy sample (Bateman rec over 27 cleared alongside 66 Henry carries). Do not pair with a total under, a Tate deep over, or a Henry under — those need the other game. No TD legs. Two legs only. Prices missing, so this is a read log, not a bet.
